name: ams-stock-worker
description: AMS 備品庫存 API（Cloudflare Worker + D1）

scripts.d1:status: wrangler d1 execute ams-stock --remote --command "SELECT pn, model, qty, loc FROM items ORDER BY pn"
scripts.d1:ledger: wrangler d1 execute ams-stock --remote --command "SELECT id, ts, emp_id, emp_name, action, pn, delta, balance, kks, note, wo FROM ledger ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30"
